pin.title: PIN
pin.none: No PIN yet. Pharmacists and managers need one for controlled drugs, approvals and witnessing.

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.turnOffBody: Your password and a code or backup code are needed. Your other sessions end and the owner is told.
twofa.resetBody: Your current key keeps working until a code from the new key is confirmed.
twofa.resetScan: Scan the new key, then enter a code from it. Your other sessions end and you get 10 new backup codes.
twofa.wrongCode: The code is wrong or has expired.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.revokeBody: It is signed out at once and must sign in again.
